from_desc: Matrix entries and free compression rank obstruction

obstruction: Wick words follow paths through matrix indices, and free compression interpolates between a change of generators and its covariance. Rare contractions can preserve invertibility despite unfavourable dimension counts, and iterative encodings force increasingly rough decoders.
lesson: Dimension counting cannot obstruct changes of generators (C17 again).

from_desc: Automatic continuity / Peterson-Thom consequences as control on rough generator changes

from_desc: BDIP sans-rank + Dykema-Zhao rescaling; Nielsen substitutions; absorption + IPP

obstruction: BDIP sans-rank + Dykema-Zhao: changing the separable parameter leaves the nonseparable component count unchanged. Nielsen substitutions mix components and destroy the commutation relations needed to transfer a separable isomorphism to the enlargements. Under Dykema-Radulescu absorption, separate IPP conjugacies do not control the free complement.

from_desc: Nonzero-mean vertex unitaries recover the root (telescoping) - "Aha!"
to_desc: Free monotone transport to remove correlations
obstruction: Free Haar vertex variables x_g on the Cayley tree have free edge increments x_g* x_{g s_i}, but reconstruction needs the missing root x_e. A classical analogy (Ornstein-Weiss) says that with non-uniform labels the shift ambiguity is resolved by empirical frequencies. With nonzero mean beta, telescoping and weak convergence give x_g* x_h -> beta x_g*, recovering every vertex, but neighbouring edges become correlated, so exact freeness disappears.
lesson: A missing generator can be recovered if freeness is sacrificed; the whole difficulty is keeping exact freeness (C19a).

from_desc: Free monotone transport to remove correlations

from_desc: Spectral gap: no free generating tuple near the free tuple (d>=2)
to_desc: Strategy NEG (again): generator-independent microstate invariant
obstruction: For d >= 2 a spectral gap bars nearby free generating tuples: the root would become an impossible approximate intertwiner. A nonfree generating set accumulates at a free tuple that is separated from all free generating tuples, so there is no Baire smoothing.
lesson: Free generating tuples cannot be reached by small perturbation of this nonfree generating construction, so generation must be obtained in a limit, not at a finite stage (C19).
lesson_form: negative result + constraint on future approaches
influence: contributory (the final route keeps exact freeness at every stage and gets generation only in the limit, L286-288 and L316-319); inferred, low confidence

from_desc: Jung hyperfinite inequality; zero-entropy shifts; separable MASAs; Shen/DSSW; commutator invariant

obstruction: Urysohn width suggests obstructing an encoding of free tuples through fewer matrix generators. Spectral clipping and Borsuk-Ulam control the whole operator-norm ball, but the obstruction cannot be restricted uniformly to a prescribed free law, and projection onto one coordinate defeats the global-negation argument.
lesson: Global topological width bounds do not localise to a free law (C20a).

from_desc: Apply the Luk-Strain/Glassey-Strauss criterion directly to the stated data.
to_desc: Field localization: Coulomb decomposition + truncated vector potentials of the divergence-free remainders + vacuum Maxwell restoration (finite propagation); smooth persistence by Picard iteration and tame Sobolev estimates; density normalization f -> f/(4 pi); constraint-preserving modification.

lesson: Bridge the data class to the Sobolev continuation theorem by changing the fields away from the particles: keep the Coulomb field of the initial density, truncate vector potentials of the divergence-free remainder, and evolve the removed part as a vacuum Maxwell field; finite propagation keeps it out of the particle region on a fixed horizon, so the particle dynamics is unchanged.

from_desc: Original length of the direction-counting windows.

lesson: Shorten the windows by a factor ~ M^2 + A log P, i.e. to length ~ min((w delta / MP)^2, w delta / (A S(w))).
